schema.name: dvmf_cor938
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE dvmf_cor938.parent (id INT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT)
CREATE TABLE dvmf_cor938.child (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NOT NULL, c1 INT, c2 TEXT, c3 INT, target_val INT NOT NULL)

query.defining_query: WITH child_max AS (SELECT parent_id, max(target_val) AS top_val FROM dvmf_cor938.child GROUP BY parent_id) SELECT p.id, cm.top_val FROM dvmf_cor938.parent p LEFT JOIN child_max cm ON cm.parent_id = p.id

mutations.sql: DELETE FROM dvmf_cor938.child WHERE id = 2 RETURNING 1
